title: Closing Charges on In-Place Home Resale Packages in Home Purchase Financing Proceeds Estimates
content:
**Closing statement line-item note — Home Purchase Financing sale paydowns**

The closing charges taken from the sale proceeds follow the package of the borrower's In-Place Home Resale file under contract:

- Where the resale package charges a commission and credits the initial inspection fee at closing, the closing charges are the package's transaction fee plus its closing fee less its inspection fee.
- Where the package charges a commission and gives no such credit, the closing charges are the transaction fee plus the closing fee.
- Where the package charges no commission, this note sets no closing charges.

| Package charges a commission | Credits the initial inspection fee at closing | Closing charges |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | transaction fee plus closing fee, less inspection fee |
| yes | no | transaction fee plus closing fee |
| no | either | not set by this note |

*Hypothetical package figures.* With a transaction fee of 395.00, a closing fee of 250.00 and an inspection fee of 150.00, a package that credits the inspection fee gives closing charges of 495.00; one that does not, 645.00.
